question: 上个月（2026年10月）的销售额是多少？只统计已交付订单，金额为商品金额之和，不含运费
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id=oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2026-10-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp<'2026-11-01'
note: 不筛状态会虚高；含运费会偏高

question: 上个月（2026年10月）已交付的订单有多少笔？
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2026-10-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp<'2026-11-01'
note: 把全部状态也算进去会多约 161 笔

question: 上个月已交付订单的平均客单价是多少？销售额÷订单数，两者同一口径、不含运费
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price)/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id=oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2026-10-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp<'2026-11-01'
note: 分子分母口径不一致就错

alts.label: 分子分母都用全部状态

question: 最近三个月（2026年8/9/10月）每个月的已交付销售额分别是多少？不含运费
sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.order_purchase_timestamp,'%Y-%m') m, ROUND(SUM(oi.price),2) gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id=oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2026-08-01' GROUP BY m ORDER BY m
note: 漏掉状态过滤，三个月全部偏高

question: 近三个月已交付订单中，销售额最高的 5 个品类是什么？品类用英文名
sql: SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english,p.product_category_name) cat, ROUND(SUM(oi.price),2) gmv FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id=p.product_id LEFT JOIN category_translation t ON p.product_category_name=t.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2026-08-01' GROUP BY cat ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 5
note: 漏 join 翻译表会得到葡语品类名

question: 在全部订单（包含取消、已发货等所有状态）中，订单数量最多的 5 个州是哪些？
sql: SELECT c.customer_state st, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id GROUP BY st ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5
note: 这题不加状态过滤，加了反而错

question: 2026 年的平均评分是多少？保留两位小数
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score),2) FROM order_reviews WHERE review_creation_date>='2026-01-01'
note: 时间条件写错会变

question: 差评（1 到 2 分）占全部评价的比例是多少？百分比保留两位小数
sql: SELECT ROUND(100*SUM(review_score<=2)/COUNT(*),2) FROM order_reviews
note: 分母是全部评价，不是已交付订单

question: 在已签收的订单中，从下单到签收平均需要多少天？保留两位小数
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(order_delivered_customer_date,order_purchase_timestamp)),2) FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
note: 未签收订单要排除，否则偏小

question: 已签收订单中，延迟送达（签收晚于预计送达）的订单占比是多少？百分比保留两位小数
sql: SELECT ROUND(100*SUM(order_delivered_customer_date>order_estimated_delivery_date)/COUNT(*),2) FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
note: 分母只能用已签收订单

question: 2026 年 10 月，各种支付方式各自有多少笔订单？
sql: SELECT p.payment_type, COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id) n FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2026-10-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp<'2026-11-01' GROUP BY p.payment_type ORDER BY n DESC
note: 不限时间范围会把全部历史算进来

question: 按订单数计算，使用分期（分期数大于1）的订单占比是多少？百分比保留两位小数
sql: SELECT ROUND(100*COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN payment_installments>1 THEN order_id END)/COUNT(DISTINCT order_id),2) FROM order_payments
note: 分母用支付记录会得到另一个数

question: 在全部订单中，销售额最高的 5 个卖家是谁？
sql: SELECT oi.seller_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.price),2) gmv FROM order_items oi GROUP BY oi.seller_id ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 5
note: 这题不限状态；加了过滤会变

question: 下过两次及以上订单的客户有多少人？按客户真实唯一编号统计
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1) x
note: 用 customer_id 会因为一单一号而全部失误

question: 上个月有多少客户是第一次下单？按客户真实唯一编号统计
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) t FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING t>='2026-10-01' AND t<'2026-11-01') x
note: 先把首单时间算出来再筛

question: 取消订单占总订单的比例是多少？百分比保留两位小数
sql: SELECT ROUND(100*SUM(order_status='canceled')/COUNT(*),2) FROM orders
note: 分母是全部订单

question: 上个月已交付订单的平均每单运费是多少？保留两位小数
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.freight_value)/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id=oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2026-10-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp<'2026-11-01'
note: 不筛状态会得到另一个数

question: 十月与九月相比，已交付销售额的环比增长率是多少？百分比保留两位小数
sql: SELECT ROUND(100*(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2026-10-01' THEN oi.price END)-SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2026-09-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp<'2026-10-01' THEN oi.price END))/SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2026-09-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp<'2026-10-01' THEN oi.price END),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id=oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2026-09-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp<'2026-11-01'
note: 基期写错会得到完全不同的数

question: 全部订单（含取消）一共卖出了多少件商品？按商品明细行计数
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items
note: 和「订单数」是两回事；加状态过滤会变

question: 全部订单（含取消）的总支付金额是多少？
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(payment_value),2) FROM order_payments
note: 先 JOIN 订单表再 SUM 会翻倍

question: 有多少个商品的品类是未知的？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE product_category_name IS NULL
note: 用 ='' 会得到 0

question: 十月包含取消订单在内，销售额是多少？用于对比「只算已交付」差多少
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price),2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id=oi.order_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp>='2026-10-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp<'2026-11-01'
note: 这题故意不筛状态；减去 838576.64 就是虚高部分
